title: Onboard nova-70b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata versioning, and changelog automation
author: Luca Moretti
description:
Motivation: Add nova-70b v1.0 to the model registry with production-ready metadata, per-hardware performance profiles, and automated changelog entries. This PR introduces model metadata (model.yaml) following the v3 schema, performance profiles for common GPU families (g4, g5, a100), a smoke test, and a changelog generation hook so releases are picked up automatically by our release notes pipeline.

Changes include: model metadata, perf CSVs, docs, tests, and a small automation script update.

Checklist:
- [x] model.yaml (schema v3) with tokenizer, family, version, default quantization recommendations
- [x] perf profiles (perf/profiles/nova-70b-v1.0.csv) with measured throughput/latency per instance type
- [x] smoke/inference test and CI job added (tests/inference/test_nova_smoke.py)
- [x] changelog automation integration: release generator now picks up new perf profiles and model metadata
- [x] sigstore checksum and artifact validation added to model onboarding pipeline

Notes: No API surface change. This is purely registry/meta + docs + tests. There is a migration note for customers pinned to legacy nova-70b-quantized: we provide a 90-day deprecation window and an automated mapping table. Related Linear tickets: ENG-4821 (model onboarding), ENG-4899 (changelog automation).

release_notes: Onboard nova-70b v1.0: Adds production metadata (schema v3), per-hardware performance profiles, smoke tests, and automated changelog generation. Recommended default quantization: 4-bit quantized variant for g4/g5; fp16 for a100. No breaking API changes. Migration notes provided for legacy pinned variants.
changelog_automation: generate_changelog.py now discovers new model metadata artifacts and emits a draft changelog entry under changelogs/auto/ with perf-summary and migration notes. The pipeline will include these drafts into the release candidate build.
metadata_changes: Introduced model.yaml (schema v3) with fields: name, version, family, tokenizer, transforms, default_quantization, recommended_hardware_profiles, checksum_url, sigstore_signature. Bumped registry schema documentation and added migration README for v2->v3.
validation_summary: Sigstore validation passed for model weights; checksum matches published artifact. Inference smoke tests passed on g4dn.xlarge and g5.xlarge; a100 test retried and passed. Perf runs show median latency and throughput within expected bounds; results recorded in perf/profiles CSV.
notes: Customers pinned to legacy nova-70b-quantized should see automatic mapping in registry:mappings/legacy_to_v1.csv. Migration window: 90 days from merged_at. Ops: a migration playbook (docs/migrations/nova-70b-migration.md) was added for Dedicated and Private deployments.
ci_details: Pipeline: model-registry-smoke (passed), perf-bench (passed), docs-build (passed), lint (passed). One transient a100 job timeout on first run rerun successfully.
test_summary: Added end-to-end smoke test that loads the model, runs a short prompt, and validates token-level output shape and latency threshold. Tests run in CI against a small sample artifact to keep cost low.
automation_notes: Changelog generation picks up perf CSVs and model.yaml fields: name, version, metrics-summary and migration notes. Maintainers can opt-out by adding 'changelog: false' to model.yaml.
